en: A monochrome postcard view of a rural landscape with a traditional wooden farmhouse and outbuildings on a hillside surrounded by trees and fields. A dirt path leads up to the house, and a split-rail fence follows the road. A few small figures stand on the path. Printed captions in Finnish and Swedish appear at the bottom, and a handwritten note in the upper right reads "v. 1905."
